item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Celine Dion - At Last (Live on Parkinson - BBC, 2002) AppleMusic WEB-DL
item.description:
This performance was uploaded in February by Celine's label, but unfortunately, the audio was pitched down. This was the version that was shared here:

https://sharemania.us/threads/celin...bc-2002-1080p-am-web-dl-aac-2-0-h-264.294263/

However, Celine's label recently corrected the pitch. Could someone please share this performance again with the corrected audio?

https://music.apple.com/us/music-video/at-last-live-on-parkinson-bbc-2002/1876657023
Thanks in advance!
